verdict: BOTH PRE-REGISTERED INSTRUMENTS DEGENERATE -- derived grouping NOT applied

why_degenerate.q: N01 = 0 in every pair, so N01*N10 vanishes and Q = 1 by arithmetic regardless of dependence. N01 is 'A wrong, B right'; it is empty because the weak observer's errors strictly contain the strong observers' errors -- nesting, which Q cannot express.
why_degenerate.double_fault: computed from N00, which holds 1, 1 and 2 observations.
why_degenerate.disagreement_posthoc: appeared to invert the hand-assignment (lookup/sequence never disagree) but fails significance: expected 2.0 disagreements under independence, observed 0, P(0 | independent) = 0.135.

conclusion: All three pairs are indistinguishable from independent by every measure computable on this data. The derived grouping is an artifact and is not applied; the hand-assigned grouping stands by default rather than by validation. The KNOWNS #2 open item is not closed -- it is better characterised: error-based coupling measures need observers that are wrong, and these are wrong once or twice in 202 cases. The phase 10 input-based measurement (AUC 0.6987, p=1.06e-06) stands and had more power here than the literature's standard instruments.
